title: fix(ui): the approval request page heads the submitted record's field groups as real sections, with section links
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBU5y97XtBcJ8qSLSR3B3Djd)_

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgwLiKcfujYUug7sPs

Closes #34707

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：审批请求页「提交时的内容」卡片里，每个字段分组的名字改成真正的分组标题（和记录页同一套样式：加粗、前景色、组图标、下方细分隔线，组间距明显大于字段行距）；记录有两个及以上带标题的分组时，卡片顶部多一条分组导航，点分组名滚到该组。
- 为什么改：原来分组名是 12px 灰字，和 11px 灰色字段标签几乎一样，40 多个字段连成一片，看不出分组（维护者原话：「还有审批单显示记录所有字段的时候是不是没有带分组」）。
- 风险与回滚：只动审批页这一张卡片的标题与导航，不改显示哪些字段、字段顺序和「已改动 / 当前值」标注；没有新导出、没有新翻译键。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-decision/SubmittedRecord.tsx` 的 `SectionHeading` 与 `SectionNav` 两个组件，以及卡片正文里调用它们的那段。
- 两分钟验证：打开 showcase 的审批收件箱，点「Expense Report Sign-off」，卡片顶部应有「Report · Totals」导航，下面两个加粗分组标题带分隔线；点「Totals」滚到该组；手机宽度标题不截断。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

On the approval request page, the "As submitted" card (`SubmittedRecordCard`) now:

1. **Heads each titled section as a real heading.** A level-4 heading (the card's own "As submitted" is level 3), in the default record page's section face: plugin-detail's `DetailSection` frameless title row (semibold, foreground colour, the group's declared icon, a hairline under it). `DetailSection` cannot be reused here: it renders its own fields and has no slot for this card's "Changed / Current value" cells, and its header is not exported on its own. So `SectionHeading` repeats that header's classes, with one change: the title wraps (`break-words`) instead of `truncate`, so a long group name is not cut off at phone width (the card's acceptance 3). Sections are now `space-y-6` apart, double the field row gap.
2. **Keeps every section open.** Unchanged behaviour, now pinned: a group declared `collapse: 'collapsed'` is drawn open, with no disclosure control.
3. **Adds section links when there are two or more titled sections.** A strip of section names at the top of the card; a click scrolls that section's heading into view. One titled section draws no strip. The nav is named by the card's own "As submitted" heading (`aria-labelledby`), so no i18n key is added.

`submittedRecordPlan.ts` carries the group's declared `icon` through to the drawn section.

Not changed: which fields show, their order, and the "Changed" mark with the current value. No exported symbol and no i18n key is added; both modules stay internal to the package.

## Why

The section label was `mb-2 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground` and the field label `text-[11px] text-muted-foreground`: one pixel and one font weight apart, in the same grey, so a record with many groups read as one run of fields.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in the shared harness `ApprovalDecisionPanel.fullRecord-34588.test.tsx`, "the submitted record heads its sections and links to them (objectstack#34707)", five cases:

- each titled section is a level-4 heading under the level-3 "As submitted", in the foreground face, not truncated, over a hairline; a field label is not a heading;
- a group declared collapsed is drawn open, with no `aria-expanded` control;
- two titled sections get a nav named "As submitted" with entries in page order; a click calls `scrollIntoView` on that section's heading;
- CONTROL: one titled section draws its heading and no nav;
- field keys per section, their order, and the single "Changed" mark are unchanged.

The existing #34588 cases (field set, order, marks, redaction) pass unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- **Reuse of the #34605 navigation.** The drawn strip of #34605, `FormSectionNav`, lives in `@object-ui/plugin-form` and is not exported from it (neither the package root nor `./core`). `@object-ui/components` exports only the reporting contract (`FormSectionNavContext`, `FormSectionNavItem`, `FormSectionNavSink`), which a `form` renderer feeds; this card has no form renderer. Exporting `FormSectionNav` would add an exported symbol and flip Clause-② to yes, so this PR does not. `SectionNav` here is a module-internal component that types its entries with `FormSectionNavItem`'s `key` / `label` / `anchorId` and uses the same strip classes. It has no scroll-spy highlight and no error counts (nothing here can be in error or folded).
- **The nav does not stick.** A sticky strip was tried in the browser. The record page's scroller pads its content (`p-3`), so the scrolled fields showed through in a 12px band above the stuck strip at 390px width. The strip now sits at the top of the card.
- **Heading size.** The card says the record page uses 14px or larger titles. The default record page's frameless face (the one an object without a custom page gets) draws 13px semibold. This PR copies that face, so the two pages match. `DetailSection` draws its 16px card face only off the default record page or on a print page (it chooses with `useDefaultRecordPage() && !isPrintPage`).
- **Seen in the browser, not part of this diff:** at 390px the record page's absolutely positioned `ManagedByBadge` ("System-managed", `RecordDetailView`) overlaps the card's "Open record" link. It was there before this change and is reported to the seat.
